app.name: Mridanga Seva
app.tagline: Class records, lessons and attendance in one place

common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.networkError: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use the email and password you signed up with.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.subtitle: Students: use the email you gave the coordinator, so your record is linked.
signUp.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
signUp.checkEmail: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your account, then sign in.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email. We will send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a link is on its way. It can take a few minutes.

validation.passwordsDontMatch: The two passwords are not the same.

authErrors.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email first. Open the link we sent you.
authErrors.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
authErrors.weakPassword: This password is too easy to guess. Choose a stronger one.
authErrors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
authErrors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the old one.

pending.title: Waiting for access
pending.body: Your account is ready. The Guru will give you access soon.
pending.studentHint: Are you a student? Ask a coordinator to put this email on your student record, then tap Check again.
pending.kiosk: The door tablet screens come in a later version.
pending.inactiveBody: This account is not active. Please speak to the Guru or a coordinator.

home.comingSoon: Your screens are being built. They will appear here.

setup.title: App not set up
setup.missing: The server address or key is missing. Copy app/.env.example to app/.env, fill in both values, then restart.
setup.secretKey: This is the secret (service_role) key. Never put it in the app. Use the publishable (anon) key instead.

scanner.label: Camera for scanning a student's QR code
scanner.permissionNeeded: The app needs the camera to scan QR codes. Nothing is recorded or saved.
scanner.permissionBlocked: The camera cannot be used: it is switched off for this app, or there is none. Switch it on in the phone's settings, or search the name below.
scanner.noCamera: The camera could not start. Search the name below instead.

attendance.title: Mark attendance
attendance.scanIntro: Ask the student to open My QR in the app and hold it in front of the camera.
attendance.noMatch: No student found. Check the spelling, or register the student.
attendance.searchFailed: Could not search. Check your internet connection.
attendance.unknownBody: This is not a student's QR code for this class. Search the name instead.

errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the Guru can mark attendance.
errors.notFound: This student is no longer in the records.
errors.alreadyMarked: Another phone marked this student at the same moment. Check the list and try again.

hereNow.title: Who is here now
hereNow.empty: Nobody is checked in right now.
hereNow.sinceEarlierDay: Since {{date}} {{time}}: not checked out that day
hereNow.confirmBody: Use this when the class closes. Each visit ends now; a visit left open from an earlier day ends at that day's closing time.

myQr.title: My QR card
myQr.howTo: Show this code to the coordinator when you arrive and again when you leave. They scan it to check you in and out.
myQr.keepPrivate: This code is only for you. Do not send a photo or screenshot of it to anyone.
myQr.savedCopy: No internet right now. This is the copy saved on your phone; it can still be scanned.
myQr.loadFailed: Could not load your QR card
myQr.noRecordBody: Your login is not connected to a student record. Please speak to a coordinator.

register.title: Register a student
register.intro: Takes about two minutes. Only the name and date of birth are required.
register.ageMinor: Age {{age}} — under 18, a parent's consent is needed
register.emailHint: The student's own email, if they will use the app. Their login is connected to this record.
register.areaHint: Only the area, e.g. Koti. Not the full address.
register.guardianIntro: Needed because the student is under 18.
register.idCheckedHint: Look at the parent's ID to confirm who they are. Do not write down the number.
register.photoConsent: The parent agrees to a photo of the student on the class record.
register.writtenConsent: The parent has filled in and signed the paper consent form, and I have kept it with the class records.
register.linked: Their app login is now connected to this record.
register.loadFailed: Could not load levels and coordinators.

errors.dobInvalid: Enter the date of birth as day-month-year, e.g. 15-06-2012.
errors.consentNeeded: The signed consent form is needed before a student under 18 can be registered.
errors.minorNeedsConsent: A student under 18 needs the parent's details, the ID check and the signed consent form.
errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the Guru can register students.
errors.fixFields: Please correct the fields marked in red.

students.title: Students
students.loadFailed: Could not load the student list.
students.empty: No student matches. Change the search or the filters.

profile.title: Student profile
profile.notFound: This student is not in the records.
profile.guardianStaffOnly: Only coordinators and the Guru can see this.
profile.consentMissing: No current consent from the parent is on record. Please tell the Guru.
profile.noSyllabus: The syllabus for this level has not been added yet.

followUp.title: Follow-up calls
followUp.intro: Students who have stopped coming. Tap a name to phone them and record the call.
followUp.loadFailed: Could not load the follow-up list.
followUp.empty: Nobody needs a call right now.
followUp.escalatedHelp: Several calls with no answer, or no call made before the student became Inactive.

callLog.title: Log a call
callLog.noPhone: No phone number on the record.

outcomeHelp.returning: They will come again. If they have not come by the day after the date, a new call is due.
outcomeHelp.paused: They are taking a break until the date (exams, travel, health). No reminders till then.
outcomeHelp.not_reachable: Nobody answered. A new try is due in a few days; after several tries the Guru is told.
outcomeHelp.discontinued: They have stopped coming. Their status becomes Left. They keep their roll number, and their next visit makes them Active again.

callLog.commentHint: Required. A short note for whoever calls next.
callLog.confirmLeftBody: They leave the follow-up list. Their record, roll number and history are kept.
callLog.confirmLeftYes: Yes, save and mark as Left

saved.returning: {{name}} is expected on {{date}}. If they do not come, a new call is due the day after.
saved.not_reachable: Saved as not reachable. A new try is on the follow-up list.

errors.dateInvalid: Enter the date as day-month-year, e.g. 15-10-2026.
errors.datePast: The date cannot be before today.
errors.commentRequired: Write what was said on the call.
errors.reasonUnknown: This reason is no longer in the list. Choose another.
errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the Guru can log calls.
errors.notFound: This student is not in the records.
